snippet.title: [Like or Die] Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
📡 SET UP THE NEW STREAM 📡
Ready to show off your epic plays?

 A team-based survival FPS where streamers clash in a fierce battle for survival,
[Like or Die] unveils its very first announcement trailer!

Subscribe to the official [Like or Die] channel now so you never miss out on the latest updates and upcoming events.
✨ Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4559400
✨ Official Website : https://likeordie.plaync.com

Want to learn more about the world of [Like or Die]? Check out this video.
🎬[Like or Die] Official Lore Trailer: https://youtu.be/TmggKJVUe70
